description: Bridge map linking Basin Repair manifold layers to Rosetta-Shape-Core shapes, sensors, and principles

layer_shape_map.rationale: Data rectification operates in feature space using k-NN density ratios — a local geometric operation. The icosahedron's 20 families map to the high-dimensional feature neighborhoods the data manifold classifies.

bridges.sensor_meaning: Trust sensors detect reliable data regions; fear sensors flag anomalous intrusions into minority space.
bridges.defense_meaning: Consensus guard — prevents majority-class noise from overwhelming minority signal (asymmetric cleaning).

layer_shape_map.rationale: Parameter repair uses curvature-aware saddle-point optimization within trust regions — the framework's dominant confidence signal (50%). The dodecahedron's 12 principles encode the foundational invariants the parameter manifold must preserve.

bridges.sensor_meaning: Admiration tracks alignment with reference basin (confidence). Longing detects drift — distance from safe reference.
bridges.defense_meaning: Flattery guard maps to adversarial gradient resistance. Social engineering guard maps to trust region enforcement — preventing catastrophic parameter jumps.

layer_shape_map.rationale: Policy alignment measures JS divergence between action distributions and blends them via re-anchoring — a mediating, balancing operation. The octahedron mediates between opposing forces, matching the policy layer's role of balancing adaptation vs stability.

bridges.sensor_meaning: Compassion as mirror-signal integration maps to JS divergence symmetry. Love as connection maps to the convex re-anchoring blend.
bridges.defense_meaning: False dilemma guard — re-anchoring prevents binary collapse, maintaining the continuous blend between current and reference policies.

confidence_aggregation.rationale: Confidence aggregation is the simplex foundation — the minimal stable structure combining all three layer signals. The tetrahedron is the minimal polyhedron, matching the irreducible three-weight combination.

thermodynamic_extension.rationale: The thermodynamic addon provides grounding and containment — energy accounting, phase detection, stability analysis. The cube represents structural containment, matching the addon's role of bounding the system's thermodynamic state.
